Application Data.NAME: The Page Turner Bookstore
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Page Turner Bookstore is a retail establishment dedicated to providing a diverse selection of books and magazines, catering to the interests of our local community. We offer a cozy atmosphere for customers to browse and discover new titles, as well as hosting author signing events and book clubs to engage our clientele. Our operations primarily focus on in-store sales, with a modest online presence that constitutes less than 25% of total sales. We maintain strong inventory controls and loss prevention measures to safeguard our merchandise. Our commitment to exceptional customer service and community involvement is at the heart of our business.
